c050ce435f073ac68da9fe719ec0fdfcd97a258f.summary: Microsoft's threat description of TrojanSpy:Win32/Usteal, a malware family that steals usernames and passwords for online games and applications and can download other malware. It is usually installed when people download other software, and other malware such as Trojan:Win32/LockScreen can also install it. Microsoft Defender Antivirus detects and removes it.

tools.q: It is also installed by other malware such as Trojan:Win32/LockScreen.

techniques.q: This family of malware steals your usernames and passwords for online games and applications.
The trojan is usually installed on your computer when you download other applications, images or software.

hedges: The report says the trojan is usually installed on a computer when people download other applications, images or software.
